اضطبنا (form VIII)
# اِضْطَبَنَا (iḍṭabanā) /idˤ.tˤa.ba.naː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# اِضْطَبَنَّا (iḍṭabannā) /idˤ.tˤa.ban.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# اُضْطُبِنَا (uḍṭubinā) /udˤ.tˤu.bi.naː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# اُضْطُبِنَّا (uḍṭubinnā) /udˤ.tˤu.bin.naː/: first-person pl
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
